policy.integrationGate: all triggered regression cases must be revalidated or explicitly NEED_HMD_TEST before integration

cases.title: Logo completes then game remains on white screen

symptomFingerprint.primary: startup reaches/passes logo then white screen and does not progress into normal game flow
secondary: recenter/input path may still respond while presentation/game progression is stuck
logSignals: correlate game/host/watchdog session timeline around first post-logo Present and stereo transport activation

rootCause.summary: A prior similar symptom was reported as fixed, but the exact root-cause/fix SHA is not durably identified in the current repository records. Reconstruct from 2026-09-20 candidate/runtime history before declaring a new root cause.

revalidationTriggers: changes to host fallback/recovery or first-frame state
changes to launch/profile/config values affecting VR activation

static: build active DX9Ex game DLL and x64 OpenXR host
runtime: confirm logo transitions into menu/game instead of persistent white frame
collect standardized OutRun2_VR_ANALYZE_*.zip if failure recurs

cases.nextAction: Reconstruct the previous 2026-09-20 fix/root cause and attach exact fix SHA/evidence; then add a deterministic no-HMD guard where feasible and retain HMD startup transition as a mandatory regression check.
